# Vihakids

> Vihakids offers live, online, one-on-one and small-batch tuitions in English, Hindi, Mathematics, Science and Kannada for school students in 1st to 10th Standard, covering CBSE, ICSE and State Board syllabus. Headquartered in Bengaluru, India, and serving students across India and abroad.

## Core pages

- [Home](https://www.vihakids.com/): Overview, subjects, programs and free demo registration.
- [Register](https://www.vihakids.com/register): Sign up for a free demo class.
- [Teach with us](https://www.vihakids.com/teach): Apply to become a Vihakids tutor.
- [Fees](https://www.vihakids.com/fees): Monthly per-subject pricing, with no registration fee and no annual contract.
- [About Us](https://www.vihakids.com/about.html): Who Vihakids is and how classes work.
- [Blog](https://www.vihakids.com/blog.html): Articles on tuitions, boards and learning tips.
- [Parent FAQ](https://www.vihakids.com/faq): Answers to the questions parents ask before choosing online tuition — class format, tutors, timings, fees, refunds, progress updates and safety.
- [Fees](https://www.vihakids.com/fees): Monthly fee per subject by grade band.

## Blog posts

- [English Grammar Basics for Kids: Parts of Speech & Present Tense](https://www.vihakids.com/blog-english-grammar-basics.html): A free, easy reference for two grammar topics every child struggles with early on — with simple examples and the mistakes to watch for.
- [How to Help Your Child Build Real Confidence, Not Just Chase Marks](https://www.vihakids.com/blog-exam-stress-confidence.html): Why chasing marks alone tends to backfire, and the everyday habits that build genuine confidence — so grades follow naturally instead.
- [How to Help Your Child Understand Science — Not Just Memorise It](https://www.vihakids.com/blog-science-learning-tips.html): Why Science homework often turns into rote memorising, and five practical ways to build real understanding at home instead.
- [5 Simple Ways to Help Your Child Read Kannada Confidently at Home](https://www.vihakids.com/blog-kannada-reading-tips.html): Small, everyday habits that build real reading confidence — no extra classes required, just 10 minutes a day done right.
- [CBSE vs ICSE vs State Board: What It Means for Kannada and Hindi Learning](https://www.vihakids.com/blog-cbse-icse-state-board-kannada-hindi.html): Each board treats second-language learning differently. Here's what parents should know before choosing extra support.
- [How to Choose the Right Online Math Tutor for Your Child](https://www.vihakids.com/blog-choosing-online-math-tutor.html): Not all tutoring is the same. A short checklist to help you spot a tutor who will actually move the needle.

## Free resources

- [Kannada alphabet (Varnamale) tracing worksheet](https://www.vihakids.com/kannada-alphabet-tracing-worksheet): Free printable worksheet covering all 15 vowels and 34 consonants, no sign-up required.
